column27: Coding, Debugging, Research / discovery, Code review
column37: I move fast but rarely read the diff line by line — bugs slip through. Letting Claude Code drive the whole feature loop is the biggest win.
Honestly I trust the output too much and skip a real review. Inline autocomplete and quick refactors save me the most time.
I generate UI fast but don't write tests for it, so regressions show up later. Scaffolding components from a screenshot has been huge.
I stick to one model for everything and probably leave quality on the table. Generating boilerplate for new screens is the standout.

column37: Onboarding teammates onto our workflows is the blocker. Saved prompt templates for data validation tasks save me hours each week.
